stem.text: When concentrated sulfuric acid reacts with sodium iodide the products include sulfur, iodine, hydrogen sulfide and sulfur dioxide.

A.text: Hydrogen sulfide is the product of a reduction reaction.

B.text: Iodide ions are stronger oxidising agents than sulfate ions.

C.text: Sulfur atoms from the sulfuric acid are both oxidised and reduced.

D.text: Sulfur atoms from the sulfuric acid are oxidised to make sulfur dioxide.
